\section{Results}
\label{sec:results}

\paragraph{Main comparison.}
Table~\ref{tab:main-results} reports accuracy, cost, and exact McNemar $p$-values against direct
generation. On Llama~3.1~8B, search reaches $0.159 \pm 0.012$, below direct generation ($0.223$),
structured prompting ($0.262$) and best-of-$N$ ($0.236 \pm 0.012$), while using 13.4 calls and
13,722 tokens per question. On Llama~3.1~70B, search reaches $0.362 \pm 0.015$ against $0.377$ for
direct generation. No method under the call budget differs significantly from direct generation
($p > 0.05$ in every seed). Compared directly, best-of-$N$ beats search in all three seeds, by 9 to
11 questions ($p = 0.05$, $0.16$, $0.09$).

\input{tables/main_results}

\paragraph{Token-matched comparison.}
Under a shared cap of 14,000 tokens per question, best-of-$N$ ($N=8$) reaches $0.228 \pm 0.022$
and search $0.151 \pm 0.018$; search is slightly below its uncapped value because the cap stops some
searches early. Best-of-$N$ again beats search in all three seeds ($p = 0.04$, $0.28$, $0.05$).

\paragraph{Search ablations.}
Table~\ref{tab:ablations} (Appendix~\ref{app:ablations}) changes one setting of the frozen 8B search
at a time. Trusting the proposer's order (fixed scoring) gives the highest accuracy,
$0.190 \pm 0.012$, against $0.159 \pm 0.012$ for the frozen search. Random, steps and vote scoring
reach $0.133 \pm 0.031$, $0.136 \pm 0.016$ and $0.108 \pm 0.008$, and $k=5$ candidates
$0.115 \pm 0.020$. Doubling the budget to 28 calls gives $0.154 \pm 0.020$ at 23.9 calls, and
removing state prediction gives $0.159 \pm 0.029$ at 3.9 calls.

\paragraph{Candidate coverage and errors.}
A correct candidate is among the root candidates in 31\% of the questions for 8B (final accuracy
16\%) and 59\% for 70B (36\%). The score-separation AUC is 0.58 for 8B and 0.53 for 70B. Most
search errors are inapplicable actions: on average per run, 75.7 inapplicable, 29.7 not closer and
4.0 format errors for 8B, against 45.0, 37.7 and 0.3 for 70B.
